national.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer API, summarized NIBRS rates (sum of monthly 'United States Offenses' rates; based on reporting agencies, ~96% population coverage — not the FBI's official national estimate)

massachusetts.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer API, summarized NIBRS rates (sum of monthly 'Massachusetts Offenses' rates; ~99.8% population coverage)

definitions.violent: FBI violent crime: murder/non-negligent manslaughter, rape, robbery, aggravated assault (simple assault NOT included)
definitions.property: FBI property crime: burglary, larceny-theft, motor vehicle theft
definitions.boston_neighborhoods: Computed from Analyze Boston incident reports: offense codes 111/301/423 (violent) and 520/530/531/540, 6xx larceny, 706/724/727 (property), deduplicated by incident+offense, geolocated incidents assigned to BPDA neighborhood polygons. Boston's public data omits sexual assaults, so Boston neighborhood violent rates exclude rape (undercount vs FBI).

Jamaica Plain.source_name: Analyze Boston – Crime Incident Reports (BPD), 2025; population = City of Boston Planning Dept. Research Division neighborhood estimate for 2025-01-01
Jamaica Plain.scaled_note: ESTIMATE: open-data rate x (FBI Boston citywide 2025 count / open-data citywide count); violent factor 1.78, property factor 1.02. Use only for rough comparison with FBI-based city rates.
Jamaica Plain.note_zh: 按 BPDA 社區邊界統計（主要屬 BPD E-13 區）。Boston 公開資料的暴力犯罪數只有 FBI 全市統計的約 56%（不含性侵等），按比例估算約 3.3／千人（全美 3.3）。
